intro: Public money is delicate. Do not touch what you do not understand.

lies.text: Every project in this budget was built and delivered.
lies.reaction: An empty field and a rusty sign. No school.

lies.text: We paid fair market prices for everything.
lies.reaction: Ten times the market price. Twelve times over.

lies.text: Every contract went to the best bidder in an open tender.
lies.reaction: A company that did not exist a week before the bid.

lies.text: Not one peso left this office without a record.
lies.reaction: The ledger and the empty field. The money went somewhere, and it was not a school.
